title: Per-team encrypted pre-delivery, timed key release and content watermarking are not implemented

original_titles.title: No per-team watermarking, file-order shuffling, or similarity/timing analysis
Round-based delivery model replaced by 4-level flow; no encrypted bundle or watermarking

problem: Current challenge files are stored and served as ordinary database-backed plaintext. There is no per-team encrypted bundle, timed key endpoint, file-order shuffle or per-team watermark manifest. These are distinct from the simpler starts_at access gate above.
impact: A user with authorized file access can copy and redistribute the same challenge bytes without team-specific attribution. The system has no cryptographic prefetch-with-T0-release mechanism.

verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Define the bundle manifest per team, challenge version and stage, containing file hashes, ordered paths, nonce/AAD metadata and a unique watermark marker that does not change executable semantics.
Encrypt each bundle using an AEAD construction (for example AES-256-GCM with unique nonce per bundle); store ciphertext separately from the key and bind AAD to event/team/challenge/version.
Implement a no-store key-release endpoint that checks stage starts_at using DB time, participant team membership, rate limit, replay/expiry and audit record before releasing the decryption key.
Add deterministic file ordering randomization per team and watermark verification tooling for leaked copies. Keep original canonical files in the restricted GT authoring domain.
Test ciphertext integrity, wrong-team key denial, pre-T0 425 response, rate limiting, replay denial and watermark attribution.

acceptance_criteria: No key is released before the stage start.
Bundle keys cannot decrypt another team’s bundle.
Manifest hashes verify all files and watermark is attributable without altering app behaviour.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.

residual_risk_or_scope_note: This is a specification-level fairness enhancement. If the event intentionally relies on access gating only, record an owner-approved scope waiver.
